input.query: SELECT CASE WHEN decision_date < DATE '2025-11-10' THEN 'before' WHEN decision_date < DATE '2026-01-08' THEN 'during' ELSE 'after' END AS period, SUM(n_approved) AS approved, SUM(n_decisions) AS decisions, SUM(n_approved)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_decisions) AS approval_rate FROM agg_kyc_daily WHERE platform = 'android' AND doc_type = 'national_id' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
